description: Read a connected list's source again now (up to 10 times a day per list). New entries arrive by the list's policy; nothing is removed.

policy.description: Optionally change what happens to new entries first: wait to be sorted (ask) or be added privately (add_private). Add and publish is set in Curated, after the person verifies the list is theirs.

name: check_source
title: Check a linked source now
